hypotheses.justification: Only the column index ι needs finiteness. After deleting this binder, apply function extensionality at i; unfolding Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum and Basis.toMatrix_apply reduces the goal to b'.sum_repr_mul_repr b m i (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/Defs.lean:641). This lemma requires Fintype ι but no finiteness of ι'. It also covers empty index types and trivial semirings.
